authority: Maintainer: lets do it, another deep push; accepted the proposed calibration-only repetition-power experiment; approved charter Tier B
target: Five-word calibration label; all600 original trials from six recordings, three people and both conditions; no exclusions
hypothesis: Calculating power separately within each repetition preserves predictive EEG-derived information that averaging waveforms first discards, including an increment beyond the fixed complete auxiliary comparator
preprocessing: Same source EEG gain, notch50/100, CAR, all-channel2-118Hz filtering on each1626-sample buffer. Raw means conventional preprocessing without adaptive residual, not unfiltered voltage. Filtered adds unchanged per-trial source NLMS using EOG/lips, seed20260906. Crop25:1625 thenfloat32 for both branches; no per-repetition normalization or cross-trial filter state.

representations.raw_evoked: 128x6 log band powers of the mean five repetition waveforms after conventional preprocessing
representations.raw_repetition: 128x6 log of mean five per-repetition band powers after conventional preprocessing
representations.filtered_evoked: 128x6 log band powers of the mean five repetition waveforms after conventional plus adaptive preprocessing
representations.filtered_repetition: 128x6 log of mean five per-repetition band powers after conventional plus adaptive preprocessing

spectral_settings: Float64 feature calculations from cropped float32 windows;320samples/repetition at256Hz; one-sided squared FFT normalized by320^2; identical six bands2-4,4-8,8-13,13-30,30-60,60-118Hz; no added taper; upperedge118included; logaftermeanpower, notmeanlogpower;768features perrepresentation
auxiliary: Unchanged392features: DISPLAY,MIC,EOG,upper/lowerlip bipolar channels including full-trial energy, plus trialindex and elapsedtime
arms: 24total: N,N_shuffled,uniform,training_prior; for each four representations R, R EEG-only,R_shuffled EEG-onlylabelshuffle,N_R,N_R_deranged,N_R_shuffled
model: Fixed one-hot ridge alpha1, unpenalized intercept, softmax, no tuning or probability calibration. Train-only centering/scaling separately per auxiliary and EEG block, each divided by sqrt(blockdimension). All EEG views have matched768features.
split_algorithms: Reuse previous five chronological20trialblocks with one neighboring trainingtrial embargo perboundary, and fixed StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=20260921). Both are retrospective within-recording; blocked fits may use later blocks. Each original trial validates once per scheme; all five repetitions remain together.
split_identity: Exact source identities and deterministic algorithms fixed before access. All six class-support/split-hash preflights recorded before any fit; missing trainingclass fails whole invocation without repairs or partial aggregate.
label_shuffle: Within training rows only, seed20260921+100*scheme_index+fold_index; same permutation for every arm in a fold; unchanged validation labels
derangement: One-position cyclic shift of EEG separately within training indices and within validation indices; auxiliaries remain aligned; same mappings for all four representations. No fold-crossing data. Fixed misalignment diagnostic, not calibrated permutation null.
primary_metric: Class-macro log loss pooled over100out-of-foldrows per person before equal-person descriptive means; balanced accuracy secondary
consistency_threshold: Primary must strictly improve log loss over all six comparators in each of allthree people within a condition under blockedvalidation. Report minimallyovert and covert separately; no pooling that hides a failure. This is descriptive discovery consistency, not significance or proof of utility; report actual gain magnitudes.
diagnostics: Target-free per-band sum of coherent and repetition powers and their ratios; ratio of sums, not mean individual ratios; all24arms/bothschemes/persons retained

interpretation.primary_pass: Exploratory predictive increment beyond this fixed auxiliary representation/model, with support for repetition-power representation. Not cortical origin; adaptive residual itself uses peripheral inputs.
interpretation.repetition_beats_evoked_not_N: Representation improvement without demonstrated conditional information beyond the auxiliary model
interpretation.raw_pass_filtered_fail: Adaptive preprocessing attenuates or transforms predictability; removed neural information and residual artifact remain competing explanations
interpretation.both_equal_beyond_N: Incremental prediction possible but no evidence waveform averaging was the bottleneck
interpretation.random_only: Time-separation-sensitive evidence, not stable held-out-block prediction
interpretation.null: No demonstrated increment from this fixed power readout, not evidence EEG lacks useful information

stop_rule: One bounded invocation after tests and remote CI. Preserve any failure with no automatic retry. Stream trials; no retained feature or waveform cache. Previous confirmation and auxiliary results remain byte-identical.
forbidden: old private targets or predictions or weights

claim_coordinates.attribution: exploratory increment beyond a fixed auxiliary predictor
